_comment: 'If you've played or created an aura this turn, this gets go again.' Two fixes. (1) SHAPE: it was an ACTIVATE with no cost -- unreachable -- so the printed GoAgain applied unconditionally and the gate was decoration; WHILE_STATIC + SOURCE_IS_ATTACK per CR 6.2.3d. (2) The condition only asked about CREATED auras, so a played aura -- the commoner half of the sentence, and the one a Runeblade deck actually does -- did not count. EVENT_THIS_TURN 'play' carries subtypes as qualifiers (play.py), so the OR expresses the printed text exactly.
